The site would also host server and AI Factory module manufacturing and on-site energy. Strasbourg Électricité Réseaux supplies 25 MW.

sea-1016-dayone-f1.summary: DayOne reports its portfolio as of September 20, 2026: 962 MW Capacity In Service and 1,328 MW Capacity Under Construction. Its NTP and KTP campuses in Johor represented 47.8% and 34.3% of Capacity In Service. Johor had 789 MW in service and 616 MW under construction, not allocated by campus. The Thailand campuses at Chonburi Tech Park had 73 MW in service and 47 MW under construction. Batam had 72 MW in service at Nongsa Digital Park and 240 MW under construction. Kuala Lumpur had 128 MW under construction across the KVTP and BTP campuses. Capacity In Service means IT power capacity ready for service and fully fitted out. Capacity Under Construction means planning, core and shell, and MEP fit-out are actively underway. Its Greater Helsinki sites have 281 MW of Bookings, all Capacity Under Construction (no capacity in service and no secured powered land in that market), across a two-campus solution in Lahti and Kouvola for one hyperscale customer; the filing does not allocate the 281 MW between the campuses. The Kouvola data centres are held through majority-owned subsidiaries with a minority shareholder.
